main.name: Emre Cosar
main.bio: Leading engineering teams with data-driven leadership and a people-first mindset. I leverage metrics to streamline delivery, creating the space to mentor engineers towards technical excellence. I believe in open communication and building solutions that make a genuine difference. Started as a full-stack engineer in bank systems. Later experienced mobile development and DevOps with microservice architectures. Then move to Software Engineerin Lead/Manager positions within multiple companies. Open and eager about two-ways personal development conversation. Clean coder, open-source committer! 'Data & Transparency' is the king!

work.title: Engineering Manager
work.description: Leading two high-performing engineering teams within the FinTech Business Unit, focused on building innovative financial solutions for global partners and driving operational excellence. I bridge the gap between technical strategy and business objectives to deliver scalable, secure systems. My teams hold end-to-end ownership of the systems responsible for partner invoice corrections, focusing on modernizing legacy infrastructure and implementing event-driven architectures to ensure seamless integration across the internal ecosystem. By combining a data-driven leadership style with a people-first mindset, I foster a culture of psychological safety and mentorship. My mission is to streamline delivery through metrics while creating the space for engineers to achieve technical excellence and make a genuine impact on the global travel experience.

work.title: Software Engineering Lead
work.description: As a software engineering lead in Funding Domain, responsible from an agile development team. The team process big data, transform and normalise it to the end-user and then showcase other Elsevier products like Scopus, Scival, Pure and etc. Responsible for product delivery, technical skillset, personal development and vision to improve and lead the team and product.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
work.description: Joined to Mendeley Data(now Digital Commons) development team to deliver more Institutional Portfolio features to the users while maintaining and replatforming legacy systems. Creating software solutions rely on microservice architecture mostly using Java, React with CI/CD pipelines running on AWS cloud environment with Terraform managed resources. Working with self-managable teams and creating DevOps culture. Excellent communication withing teams in and outside of the company.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
work.description: In the mobile banking application team, contributed to both native Android and iOS applications and the backend service. After the release, moved to the infrastructure core team to create micro services architectures with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud for core banking domains like Tax and Billing. Using TDD approach and cloud contract tests. Sticks with clean code principles.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
work.description: As a full stack developer inside Web Technologies & Social Media Applications Department, maintained bank's public website and developed a adaptive mobile version of it. Created Twitter and Facebook web applications that bank's customers use and enrolled campaigns using Facebook pages and Twitter posts. Also part of team that developed the iGaranti(and then GarantiOne) web, facebook and mobile applications. Developed notification based Google Glass application with one of my peer, was first in Turkey, for iGaranti mobile application. Created new products and platforms for our customers to touch in so many ways. In every aspects of application development processes; designing the architecture, creating web and backend level.

work.title: Software Engineer Intern
work.description: As an intern in Gdansk/Poland for 3 months, worked at CRM based company, Netz. First business experience was about java based desktop applications and three different Android applications about viewing CRM document and tracking customer-cargo locations.

education.description: Bachelor's thesis is ontology based issue tracking systems integration. Common and general ontology is designed and modelled for understanding different issue tracking systems and running in between. Also common tools and algorithms will be used for inferencing and generating graphical visualisation.
